headline: Special Called Board Meeting Held June 17, 2026
summary: At a special called morning meeting the board approved five hires, five resignations, a retroactive field trip and textbook deletions. It also approved the lowest quote from EMA Educational Materials Specialist, Inc. for the district's Pathways Assessment renewal.

personnel.note: Hires include 2 ATSI tutors, a counselor, a substitute bus driver and an assistant soccer coach; two of those hired also resigned prior positions.
